meta.title: Our impact
meta.description: Money raised by our branches and approved by head office, month by month. Every figure is checked line by line before it appears here.

hero.title: Every rupee here has been checked and approved.
hero.lead: These are the amounts our volunteers collected and head office approved, one weekly report at a time. Nothing still waiting for review is counted, and nothing is rounded up.

figures.reportsHint: Each one reviewed line by line before it was approved.

branches.title: Where the work happens
branches.lead: Our active branches, grouped by city. Each one is run by volunteers from its own neighbourhood.
branches.empty: Our first branches are getting ready. Please check back soon.

method.title: How we count
method.body: Only money in weekly reports that head office has approved is counted here. Money still waiting for review, or sent back for a correction, is left out until it is approved. These are totals only: no names, no contact details and no individual gifts are ever shown.

cta.title: Be part of next month's figures
cta.lead: Volunteer with a branch near you, or help start one in your neighbourhood.
